messages:
julia_cs: Heads up — launching a lightweight coach + warm-prefill for BetaCorp this Friday 10:00 PT. Goal: reduce first-10-min errors, collect targeted feedback for onboarding UX.

sam_csm: Love it. Proposal: small warm pool (2 GPUs -> target 2 workers), 8 short prefill sequences, and a 24h feedback ping. Main risks: early token cost and possible model mismatch on slot-fill prompts.

kevin_tse: Add: include 1 structured eval that tests tool calls and redaction. If we see >3% semantic failures on the eval set, tag as "escalate:product".

julia_cs: Can someone paste the exact prefill payload I should hand to infra? I want to run it from the support laptop.

prefill-bot: Prefill job template below (replace $TOKEN and $TENANT):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"$TENANT","requests":[{"prompt":"onboard_welcome","count":3},{"prompt":"profile_slot_fill","count":5}],"cache":"prefix","kv_ttl":3600,"target_warmpool":"betacorp-warm"}'
```

sam_csm: Notes: keep each sequence <=100 tokens, vary user names/ids to warm KV caching across shards, and avoid heavy tool invocations during initial prefill.

julia_cs: Thanks. ops will spin up warmpool ">>betacorp-warm<<" at T-30m to pre-warm hosts. Any recommended fallbacks?

kevin_tse: Fallback plan: 1) If overall latency P95 > 300ms for 10m window, scale down warm pool and route new traffic to small-quantized. 2) If error-rate spikes >4% for slot-fill group, enable heuristics: increase max_tokens cap to avoid truncation or switch to beam-infer for slot-fill prompts.

product-ops: For capture: we should create a short feedback form with these fields: 1) Did the assistant fill slots correctly? (yes/no), 2) Example failing input (text), 3) Severity (low/medium/high), 4) Email (optional). Link should be in coachmark.

sam_csm: Also capture first-touch CSAT at 24h. If CSAT <= 4/10 or failure examples >2, tag tenant: "renewal_watch" and schedule AM sync within 48h.

julia_cs: I'll post coachmark copy + feedback link here before we go live. Quick copy draft: "Welcome! Try these example prompts to get started. If something looks off, tap 'Report' to send a short note to our team. We'll follow up within 24 hours." Thoughts?

kevin_tse: Short and good. Add one example showing a tool call (e.g., "Update calendar to next Tuesday at 3pm") so users see capability surface.

prefill-bot: Warmpool schedule created: warmpool_id=wp-betacorp-2024-11-15, start=2024-11-15T16:30:00Z, target=2, ramp_minutes=10. Prefill job queued: job_id=prefill-1758887777-1.

sam_csm: Quick checklist before go-live: 1) warm pool up and healthy, 2) run prefill, 3) run eval set (10 prompts), 4) enable coachmark, 5) monitor latency+error for 60m.

julia_cs: Running prefill at 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll paste results + eval diffs and any highlighted failures. If anything looks off I'll hit rollback.

kevin_tse: Rollback snippet if needed:

```bash
# scale warmpool to 0
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/warmpools/wp-betacorp-2024-11-15/scale \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target":0}'
```

product-ops: If we tag "renewal_watch" let's include: first-touch CSAT, number of unique failed prompts, and whether fallback was triggered. That helps AMs prioritize outreach.

sam_csm: One more ops tip: for prefill, stagger request bursts across 30s windows to avoid sudden scheduler pressure. Use randomized jitter on the client.

julia_cs: Great. I'll own execution and the 24h check-in. If we hit any escalation criteria I'll loop AMs and product. Thanks team.
